Creation Methods

Methods for creating entities in RecurDyn models.

Method Reference

Method Description
CreateBody(name, mass) Creates a new rigid body with specified name and mass.
CreateJoint(type, body1, body2) Creates a joint connection between two bodies.
CreateMarker(name, body, position) Creates a marker at specified position on a body.
CreateForce(type, marker1, marker2) Creates a force element between two markers.
CreateArc(center, radius, startAngle, endAngle) Creates an arc geometry.
CreateBody(name, mass)

Creates a new rigid body in the model.

Parameters
  • name (str) – The name of the body
  • mass (float) – Mass value in kg
Returns

The created Body object

CreateJoint(type, body1, body2)

Creates a joint connecting two bodies.

CreateMarker(name, body, position)

Creates a marker on a body at the specified position.

CreateForce(type, marker1, marker2)

Creates a force element between two markers.

CreateArc(center, radius, startAngle, endAngle)

Creates an arc geometry for curves.

CreateSpring(marker1, marker2, stiffness)

Creates a spring element with specified stiffness.

CreateDamper(marker1, marker2, coefficient)

Creates a damper element with specified damping coefficient.

CreateContact(geometry1, geometry2)

Creates contact between two geometries.

CreateMotion(joint, expression)

Creates a motion on a joint with specified expression.

CreateRequest(name, type, entity)

Creates a request to output simulation results.
